scope: Only the unstd.serde._json_native C extension and adjacent headers are instrumented. CPython, orjson, msgspec and other third-party libraries are not rebuilt with sanitizers.
toolchain:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin
campaign: ASan and UBSan, existing complete serde contracts, focused native guarantee tests, deterministic bounded stress and repeated-call allocation checks
leak_scope: Process-lifetime leak detection is disabled, matching CI. Address/undefined-behavior diagnostics are fatal. Operation-local retention is measured separately with tracemalloc after warmup.

runs.label: focused-stack-after-return
command: not perf and not chaos and not concurrency

findings.kind: CPU bound in native eligibility proof
findings.description: Review found that a PY_SSIZE_T_MAX visit budget could traverse an exponentially expanded alias DAG for an impractical duration before reaching the backend.
findings.resolution: The final kernel uses MAX_WIDE_VALUES=262144 for wide, indented and transport proofs; the original compact helper retains MAX_VALUES=65536. Direct-helper cap and alias-DAG regressions are included in test_jsonx_encode_guarantees.py.

retained_memory_tests.note: These repository-owned cases retain the meaningful stress/allocation coverage explored by the initial temporary worker; they run below on every instrumented ABI.

initial_retained_memory_tests.note: These repository-owned cases retain the meaningful stress/allocation coverage explored by the initial temporary worker; they run below on every instrumented ABI.

summary.note: Final counts include complete serde suites, the retained native memory file and its stricter explicit resources lane on all three ABIs. Earlier exploratory and initial-resource runs remain recorded separately.

reporting_notes: Focused Python3.12 sanitizer worker passed; an evidence-only parser initially assumed every JUnit property was JSON. The parser was corrected to preserve scalar string properties as strings; no test rerun or product change was necessary.

publication_normalization.note: Consumer labels, artifact paths and machine-specific origins normalized for public publication. Historical timings, measured payload bytes and original source digests retain their captured meaning; normalized source/archive bytes have their own publication hashes.
